design: At each pressure state propose original fixed-pool and dynamic-pool plans, with the same top4 cap and existing fallback. Keep fixed-pool unless dynamic's estimated local loss advantage exceeds two standard deviations. Compare exact immediate spill bytes and horizon64 probability-weighted future read/write + penalty lower-bound1. Restrict changes to all-PROBE states and preserve scan/cycle paths.
uncertainty: Weighted sample effective n=(sum w)^2/sum(w^2); Dirichlet-smoothed p as before; variance of paired per-request coefficient. This is an IID variance proxy, not a guaranteed bound under selected/correlated observations.
source_ablation: Maintain separately decayed periodic histogram. Veto dynamic if periodic estimated loss minus two standard deviations is positive. Low periodic sample count yields no strong veto, not false agreement.
pilot: Original 80 train flows only, frozen sources, compare existing Best/decay64_fixed_pool/decay64 reports; no dev/eval. No parameter sweep.
data_request: Fresh IID size/heat relationship matrix, B independent, long flow and same-marginal temporal-correlation checks; parent owns common dataset and large panel.
